_comment: The brain pointer. Holds no secret. This file is the kit's tracked EXAMPLE and default: fill in database_url once, for everyone, and commit it, so a fresh clone lands on the same brain. Alternatively keep the real config OUTSIDE the kit: kb.py uses the first of $KB_CONFIG (explicit path), $AGENT_KIT_OVERLAY/projects/<project>/kb.config.json, $AGENT_KIT_OVERLAY/kb.config.json, then this file. <project> is $AGENT_KIT_PROJECT, else the cwd's git repo name, else 'global'. `kb status` prints which file was chosen. Keys starting with _comment are ignored.
_comment_database_url: Explicit libpq DSN of the Postgres + pgvector brain, e.g. 'host=db.example.com port=5432 dbname=loop_kb user=loop_rw sslmode=require'. Never defaulted: an empty value is an error. KB_DATABASE_URL in the environment (or kb --db) overrides it. A loopback / unix-socket host is refused unless scope is single-machine or KB_ALLOW_UNSHARED=1.
_comment_scope: Who the brain is for. shared (default): one brain for every developer and machine; a local host is refused. single-machine: one person's brain on this machine, used across all of their projects (rows are separated by project); a local host is allowed as a declared choice. Set it only in a config that names a local database on purpose.
_comment_auth: auth.mode is one of: password (DSN / PGPASSWORD / ~/.pgpass, or the env var auth.password_env names, default KB_DB_PASSWORD, usually set in the secret env file) | url_env (the full DSN with its credential lives in the env var auth.env names, default KB_DATABASE_URL) | token_command (auth.command, an argv list or shell string that prints a short-lived DB token used as the password, e.g. a cloud CLI's generate-db-auth-token).
_comment_embedding: provider: openai | openai-compatible (set embedding.base_url for a self-hosted or gateway endpoint) | stub (TEST-ONLY, never for real rows). api_key_env NAMES the env var holding the key; the key itself lives in the secret env file. Changing dim means re-rendering the schema: kb schema --dim N --apply.
_comment_secret_env_file: Gitignored, per machine, NEXT TO whichever kb.config.json was chosen (the kit's or an overlay's): the embedding key (the variable api_key_env names) and, for auth.mode password, KB_DB_PASSWORD.
